Quarterly ledger review

Every invoice, payout, and adjustment for the quarter in one reconciled view. Filter by client, export the balance sheet, and close the period without a second spreadsheet.

Totals reconcile against the bank feed nightly, so the number you read here is the number your accountant will see. Unmatched transactions stay in a separate queue until someone resolves them.

Access is scoped per workspace. Reviewers can read and comment; only owners can approve a close or reopen a settled period.
